description: Observatory regression limits: all 15 areas use runtime architecture. Total build measured at 3.43 MB after replacing palace bakes; 4.3 MB cap prevents retired assets re-entering the release, with headroom for the optional, dynamically-imported three/webgpu chunk (~162 KB gzip) added alongside the WebGL2 fallback renderer. Source media is streamed and measured separately. Startup JS rose to ~220 KB gzip with the palace's second pass (terrain, stairs, the plaque loader and the portal's intent and shader); the cap is 230 KB.
